wins.label: Process Technology Execution
wins.evidence: We became the world's first high-volume manufacturer of logic devices using EUV... Intel 3 achieved manufacturing readiness in Q4 as committed

wins.label: Q4 Beat & Cost Savings
wins.evidence: We delivered solid Q4 results exceeding expectations for the fourth quarter in a row... comfortably meeting our $3 billion cost savings commitment for fiscal year '23

wins.label: IFS Momentum & Design Wins
wins.evidence: In total, across wafer and advanced packaging, our lifetime deal value for IFS is now over $10 billion, more than doubling from the $4 billion

wins.label: AI PC Launch Success
wins.evidence: We expect to ship approximately 40 million AIPCs in 2024 alone with more than 230 designs from ultrathin PCs to handheld gaming devices

wins.label: CCG Strong Performance
wins.evidence: CCG performed very well in Q4, posting the third consecutive quarter of double-digit sequential growth

risks.label: Q1 Revenue Decline
risks.evidence: discrete headwinds, including Mobileye, PSG and business exits, among others, are impacting overall revenue, leading to a lower Q1 guide

risks.label: Mobileye Inventory Correction
risks.evidence: Mobileye is experiencing a sharp inventory correction in Q1

risks.label: Data Center Q1 Weakness
risks.evidence: We expect Q1 Data Center revenue to decline double-digit percent sequentially before improving through the year

risks.label: Margin Pressure from Depreciation
risks.evidence: We expect depreciation to grow by approximately $2 billion in 2024, in addition to a significant increase in variable factory start-up costs

risks.label: Manufacturing P&L Under Pressure
risks.evidence: our manufacturing P&L is under significant pressure as we get back to process leadership and build the infrastructure
